[SWS_BswM_00211] ⌈If the BswMDevErrorDetect switch is enabled, the routine
shall check if the BSW Mode Manager is initialized. In case of an error, the BswM shall
ignore the mode request and report the error to the Default Error Tracer with the error
code BSWM_E_UNINIT.⌋(SRS_BSW_00406)
[SWS_BswM_00212] ⌈If the BswMDevErrorDetect switch is enabled, the parameter
EventHandlerStatus shall be checked for being in the allowed range. In case of an error
the BswM shall ignore the mode request and report the error, to the Default Error Tracer
with the value BSWM_E_REQ_MODE_OUT_OF_RANGE.⌋(SRS_BSW_00323)
